notes: **Fix (PR #24):** Represent Android task lists, including empty lists, stable IDs, icons, pins and deletion tombstones. **Fix (PR #24):** Pull and merge taskLists through cloud settings, local persistence and Android data-only backups. **Fix (PR #24):** Patch newer Windows list edits into the existing settings document without replacing Android-only preferences or unknown task-list fields. **Fix (PR #24):** Show list cards, list-scoped tasks, Unsorted and All tasks across the existing four Windows designs. Keep the existing task layouts inside lists. **Fix (PR #24):** Add task-list selection to the item editor and respect the opened list when creating tasks. **Fix (PR #24):** List removal keeps tasks in Unsorted and retains a sync tombstone. **Fix (PR #24):** Manual Sync now performs full collection reads. Scheduled full reads record completion per collection instead of sliding the deadline on every delta poll. **Fix (PR #24):** Report malformed record/settings failures rather than claiming successful synchronization; cancel old-session work and reset caches under the sync gate. **Verification status (PR #24):** Added 13 regression tests, including a real DesktopCloudSync/FirestoreTransport cycle against a synthetic Android-shaped HTTP server. **Verification status (PR #24):** Ru
